Dependency on Third-Party APIs iGMS is dependent on Airbnb, Vrbo, and other channel APIs. When Airbnb changes something, hosts often experience the consequences before the PMS can adapt. 4. Less Control Compared to Native Platform Management Some Airbnb settings and features work best when managed directly inside Airbnb. Adding a PMS introduces another layer between you and the booking platform. 5. Learning Curve For operators with multiple properties, there is a setup process. Mistakes during onboarding can affect calendars, pricing, messaging, and availability. 6. Direct Booking Management Challenges If you manually manage direct bookings through Airbnb calendar blocks, you need to verify exactly how those blocks are handled after integration.
